invariants: SkillHub distributes only the orchestration Skill; the course package is obtained from the configured GitHub Release channel.
The release manifest, package size and package SHA-256 are validated before extraction or activation.
Remote release manifests and packages require HTTPS; loopback HTTP is reserved for local validation.
A new ZIP is fully extracted and hash-validated in staging before it can become an installed version.
An installed version directory is immutable and may not be overwritten by different bytes.
The active version changes only through one atomic current-course.json replacement.
A failed installation or validation leaves the active pointer unchanged.
Rollback changes only the active course pointer and never rewrites learner archive files.
Course installation and version switching never require a learner archive path.
